exit.vector: camera Z-in (+scale 0.0276/s on .screen-world, 1.02 -> 1.10 linear over 13.1-16.0s); ~4.8 canvas px/s outward flow at the form edge. Cursor parked and still, device locked at cx 737, cy 540.

entry.vector: lateral wizard advance: step body slides +x (screen-right, RTL-forward) from -46px on power3.out over 0.55s => ~237 canvas px/s at t=0. In-phone camera starts at rest (scale 1.0); Z push to the club wall begins at 0.9s.

carrier.steps: 5-step .steps row, index 2 (מועדונים). At t=0 it renders in frame 04's landed state (חשבון done, אימות current); at 0.15-0.60s אימות flips to .done and מועדונים to current. Holds through the final second for frame 06 to inherit.
carrier.device: the phone is never rebuilt: same .device, same slot, no entrance tween.
carrier.data: the four clubs picked here (רמי לוי, שופרסל, סופר-פארם, Be) are the film's canonical four; counter lands on 4.
